## Change

Describe the concrete workflow or correction and its source.

- [ ] Original source, author, source publication date, evidence type and category are present
- [ ] Claims, affiliations, limitations and tool dependencies match the source
- [ ] Duplicate sources and shared media have been checked
- [ ] All root-post source media slots are preserved; video previews link to playback
- [ ] English, Chinese and Japanese README content and structured data match
- [ ] `python3 scripts/build.py` and `python3 scripts/validate.py` pass
- [ ] Public release media is migrated to R2 and rendered on GitHub before publication
- [ ] Related API/skill repositories are linked only after route verification; no API/skill release changes are mixed in
- [ ] No secrets, private material or unrelated changes are included
